contexts.text: The Spirits could not bear the presence of (the Angel).
The other Spirits said that they could not bear his presence, because he wanted to be greater than others.
Evil Spirits cannot endure aversion for the evils and falsities in which their life consists.
The common belief is... that He thus bore our iniquities. AC 2776:end.
That they could not bear these things on account of the Divine that was in them. Signified.
This impending condemnation, Jehovah God bore through His Human, which was Divine Truth... TCR 3.
